title: MASI desk: a venue, docket and provenance desk (local rehearsal)
description: The MASI desk lets a person, a group or an institution launch and run a journal, a conference or a book, and keep the docket, IRB and intellectual-property matters of their own submissions, as append-only events folded into current state, with regenerable indexes. This release is a local rehearsal of a partial implementation of the canon in desk-requirements.md. It does not mint, push or stamp on its own behalf. docs/CHECK.md records what was checked, the defects corrected before release, and what of the canon is not yet implemented, including blind arrival, which is refused in this release.
